description.narrative: Ipas works to improve women's and girls' sexual and reproductive health and rights (SRHR) by improving their access to safe abortion and contraception. The organisation is technically strong and a well-respected actor with strong impact and extensive operations at global, regional and national level in about 30 countries. The initiative is central to achieving the expected results within the thematic strategy for Sweden's development cooperation on health and sexual and reproductive health and rights (SRHR) 2025–2029. They have proven to have strong impact and large scope globally and nationally. A central starting point for Ipas is that access to safe, legal abortion is critical for women’s and girls’ health, well­being, and is a fundamental human right which make their relevance for gener equality strong. Ipas is assessed to have a very good understanding of the environmental challenges the world is facing and have developed a strong environmental and climate impact analysis to identify opportunities for a positive impact from the contribution on the environment.

Ipas är en civilsamhällesorganisation som arbetar med att förbättra kvinnors och flickors sexuella och reproduktiva hälsa och rättigheter (SRHR) genom att förbättra deras tillgång till säker abort och preventivmedel. Organisationen är tekniskt stark och en väl ansedd aktör med stark genomslagskraft och omfattande verksamhet på global, regional och nationell nivå med verksamhet i ca 30 länder. Insatsen är central för att uppnå förväntade resultat inom den tematiska strategin för Sveriges utvecklingssamarbete för hälsa och sexuell och reproduktiv hälsa och rättigheter (SRHR) 2025–2029. En central utgångspunkt för Ipas verksamhet är att tillgång till säker, laglig abort är avgörande för kvinnors och flickors hälsa och välbefinnande, och en grundläggande mänsklig rättighet vilket gör deras verksamhet fullt relevant också för jämställdhet. Ipas bedöms ha god förståelse för de miljöutmaningar världen står inför och har de senaste åren anpassat sin verksamhet för klimatförändringar.

Ipas' VISION: A world where every woman and girl has the right and ability to determine her own sexuality and reproductive health
Ipas' MISSION: Women and girls have improved sexual and reproductive health and rights through enhanced access to and use of safe abortion and contraceptive care
The Ultimate Outcome is to create sustainable abortion ecosystems, defined as a dynamic condition in which resilient local stakeholders and systems are actively accountable and committed to abortion rights and responsive to everyones abortion needs. It is described in Ipas Theory of Change upon which their Strategic Plan is based on. Ipas current strategic plan is valid until 2029.
The theory of change has three immediate outcomes:
1. Increased Political Support and Leadership: Efforts that support legal and policy advocacy that improves gender-responsive policies, legislation, and financial commitments to safe abortion care.
2. Improved Knowledge and Support: Efforts that ensure that accurate information on abortion is available and accessible, people have access to medical abortion (MA) drugs with or without a prescription, abortion decisions are based on need and preference, and pathways to abortion are clear and accessible.
3. Strengthened Pathways (service provision): Efforts that ensure that pathways to abortion are clear and accessible and that access to abortion is readily available and integrated throughout the health care system, with services free of stigma, respectful of human rights, and available through a trained and supported health workforce that meets service delivery standards.
And one crosscutting outome:
4. Reduced abortion stigma: Because stigma is a major barrier to improving abortion access, Ipas includes stigma reduction as a cross-cutting outcome.

tag.narrative: 3.7 - By 2030, ensure universal access to sexual and reproductive health-care services, including for family planning, information and education, and the integration of reproductive health into national strategies and programmes.

3.7 - Senast 2030 säkerställa att alla har tillgång till sexuell och reproduktiv hälsovård, inklusive familjeplanering, information och utbildning, och att reproduktiv hälsa integreras i nationella strategier och program.

5.6 - Ensure universal access to sexual and reproductive health and reproductive rights as agreed in accordance with the Programme of Action of the International Conference on Population and Development and the Beijing Platform for Action and the outcome documents of their review conferences.

5.6 - Säkerställa allmän tillgång till sexuell och reproduktiv hälsa och reproduktiva rättigheter i enlighet med överenskommelserna i handlingsprogrammet från den internationella konferensen om befolkning och utveckling, Pekingplattformen samt slutdokumenten från respektive översynskonferenser.
